title_zh: ShowUI：面向GUI视觉智能体的统一视觉-语言-动作模型
one_line: Single 2B VLA grounder/navigator: UI-graph token selection, interleaved vision-action history, curated data; evidence mostly offline ScreenSpot/AITW/Mind2Web plus small MiniWob online check.
one_line_zh: 2B端到端VLA模型，用UI连通图做视觉token选择、交错视觉-动作历史与精选数据；证据以离线基准为主，仅MiniWob小规模在线验证。

online_eval.quote: Online on MiniWob [ 40 ] , an online environment with two types of actions, introduced to complement the offline benchmarks and test performance in an interactive setting.

held_out_env.quote: The cross-website and cross-domain settings are harder than cross-tasks. This suggests the bottleneck is lie in UI visual perception rather than textual task understanding (websites/domains are unseen in training).

variance.quote: Our key finding is that despite the simplicity of the Miniwob UI, the gap between ShowUI’s zero-shot performance (27.1%) and fine-tuned Qwen-VL (48.4%) is substantial.

strong_baselines.quote: Notably, ShowUI-2B’s zero-shot yield comparable with SeeClick-9.6B which has pretrained and fine-tuning , and achieves relatively high Op. F1 (80%+).

cost_reported.quote: Token Selection - UI-Graph offers a good balance with a 1.5× speedup and competitive accuracy.

component_ablation.quote: Without interleaved streaming (i.e., without visual history), ShowUI provides only a 1.1% acc. improvement over the VLM baseline. However, with visual history, ShowUI achieves an additional 1.7% acc. gain

evidence_level.quote: Online on MiniWob [ 40 ] , an online environment with two types of actions, introduced to complement the offline benchmarks and test performance in an interactive setting.

S2.quote: our development of UI-Guided Visual Token Selection allows for efficient processing of high-resolution UI screenshots, significantly reducing computational costs.

S3.quote: This suggests that text grounding ability mainly learned from web and mobile is transferable across platforms.

S4.quote: This allows us to standardize actions from diverse devices into a unified format.

F3.quote: Notably, ShowUI, as the most lightweight method with minimal training data , achieves state-of-the-art grounding performance.

F4.quote: The icon track is more challenging due to its visual grounding. Mobile scores are significantly higher than desktop and web, this emphasize the missing of visual UI grounding data beyond mobile devices .

AP7.quote: This suggests that offline instruction-tuning alone is insufficient; we need to develop a learning strategy tailored for an online environment , which can handle novel error cases.

AP10.quote: Our collected 22K web data outperforms SeeClick’s 270K screenshots; additionally, filtering web data by visual criteria significantly reduces element size without impacting performance
